Collect all 5 colors and blend them together with a Blend Token for a Rainbow Miner Token!

Rainbow Miner Tokens can be staked for a base rate of 50 $DREAM per day, thats an increase of 10X!

GET BLEND TOKENS [HERE](https://wax.atomichub.io/market?collection_name=virtualdream&order=asc&schema_name=tokens&sort=price&symbol=WAX&template_id=239687)

This blend is pre minted!
The mint # of the NFT you receive will be random from 1-2000

blends.name: Deranged
blends.desc:
Turn a blend token into one of three insane dreams!
Each one has an equal chance of being created. (33.33333333%)

The templates are set to infinite so a random one can be chosen when you blend, after this has reached 300 blends the templates will be locked forever!
